name: Huntington Moose Lodge
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: moose318.com, sdli.org, genecasey.com.
parkingNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible parking lot.
accessibilityNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking lot.
reviewNotes:
No working official website: Google Maps lists moose318.com but it did not resolve on 2026-10-03. Address/phone verified on SDLI's venue page and Google Maps. Hosts SDLI Tuesdays and DancXchange Club Night (4th Fridays).

Directory research 2026-10-04: moose318.com DOES work, but only over plain http (https fails), which explains the earlier 'did not resolve' note; the site looks unchanged since about 2015. Its footer says the lodge is open Mon, Tue & Thu 7:30-10 PM, but Bing's listing shows Mon 6-10 PM and Tue-Thu 7-11 PM, so hours were left out. No lodge logo of usable size on its site (the text logo is 305x52), so the Moose International emblem from mooseintl.org is used per the lodge/organization rule. The stage photo is in the lodge site's media library (Rockabilly Rumble 5, 2015) but not shown on a current page because the site's slider is broken. Bing also lists a second entry 'The Loyal Order of Moose: Lodge 318' at 631 Pulaski Rd #1703, same phone.

logo.alt: Blue Moose International logo: the word MOOSE with a moose head and antlers rising from the letters

photos.alt: The lodge hall set for a holiday party, with round tables in white cloths around a large wood dance floor and a stage at the far end
A rockabilly band with guitars, upright bass and a singer playing on the lodge's low stage in front of a brick wall under red stage lights

evidence.note: Lodge's own site (works over http only, not https) gives 631 Pulaski Road, Greenlawn, NY 11740, phone 631-757-2777 and links its Facebook page moose318.
Hall rental page invites people to call 631-757-2777 to see the hall; the dance-floor photo is attached to this page in the site's media library.
Swing Dance Long Island holds its Tuesday dances (lesson 7:30 PM, dancing to 10-10:30 PM) at Huntington Moose Lodge, 631 Pulaski Road, Greenlawn.
Rockabilly band nights (the Rockabilly Rumble series) are held at the Moose Lodge, matching the stage photo from the lodge's site.
